## pi-web-ui 0.6.5

- The right panel shows progress inferred from the current conversation's actual tool calls and results. Steps link back to their chat messages and files.
- A quiet model request and a long-running tool now have distinct, conversation-scoped status. The composer and footer show the same state, and retry is limited to a request with no tool side effects.
- Consecutive file writes share one card with file names, sizes and expandable previews. The conversation file list groups paths by operation and directory.
- Long bash commands now expand and collapse visibly.

The npm package is `@youweichen/pi-web-ui@0.6.5`. The release workflow builds unsigned desktop installers for macOS, Windows and Linux.
